skeleton.title: Data pipeline ready; pages arrive with Phase 3
skeleton.body: This repo is a pure renderer (D7): it produces no content and only consumes structured process assets from the abnk-asdm repository. The project skeleton, i18n mechanism and data contract are now locked (Phase 1, task 1.2); the eight-section pages and narrative content follow in later phases.
skeleton.phaseNote: Current stage: Sprint v0.0.1 · Part 04 · Phase 1 · Task 1.2
